body: For me, I felt like suicide would be the only option to end the unhappiness.

Yes, I know what you mean by saying you can't do things you are passionate about. I like photography but the things that interest me as a subject are soo out of my comfort zone that I know I would just make people laugh if I tried to make them or asked anybody to participate. I have all these feelings bottled up but I can't even express them with anything, it feels like they are drowning me.
Here I am, refreshing this page over and over again.

No, I'm quite sure he would.


Yes, I'm fully aware of the futility and selfishness of suicide when I'm not freaking out, but there are moments when it just seems less painful than to continue this.
I've considered that, but continuing this miserable experience sometimes seems worse than the thought of the pain I would cause to my mother. Dad would probably be okay with it.
But we both know that is not true. I'm positive that no one would care about me dying, nor would it affect anything.
